content_sections.heading: Contai Nulia Civil Defence Volunteer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The Contai Nulia Civil Defence Volunteer Recruitment 2026 has announced 45 vacancies. The vacancy distribution includes 30 posts for male candidates and 15 posts for female candidates.

content_sections.heading: Contai Nulia Civil Defence Volunteer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Contai Nulia Civil Defence Volunteer Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the required eligibility conditions mentioned in the official notification. Candidates must have passed Madhyamik (10th Standard) or equivalent examination from a recognized board. Applicants must also have completed Civil Defence Basic Training. The age of candidates must be between 18 years and 38 years as on 01 January 2026. Applicants must be permanent residents of Contai Sub-Division.

content_sections.text: The selected candidates will be engaged on a daily wages basis. The official notification does not specify the exact daily wage amount.

content_sections.heading: Contai Nulia Civil Defence Volunteer Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for Contai Nulia Civil Defence Volunteer Recruitment 2026 consists of the following stages: Physical Measurement Test (PMT) Physical Efficiency Test (PET) Written Examination Candidates qualifying in PMT will be allowed to participate in PET. The PET includes running, swimming, floating in water, diving, moving articles in water, and push-ups. Candidates qualifying in PET will appear for a written examination. The written test will be OMR-based and conducted in MCQ format. The examination will carry 50 marks with a duration of 1 hour.

content_sections.text: Candidates can apply through offline mode by collecting the application form from the SDO Office, Contai during standard working hours on working days. Fill out the application form correctly. Attach required documents including age proof, residential proof, Madhyamik certificate, and Civil Defence Training Certificate. Submit the completed application form at the designated counter of SDO Office, Contai by 14 August 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is Contai Nulia Civil Defence Volunteer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Contai Nulia Civil Defence Volunteer Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment notification issued by the Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer, Contai for engagement of Nulia Civil Defence Volunteers.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Contai Nulia Civil Defence Volunteer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 45 vacancies are available, including 30 male vacancies and 15 female vacancies.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Contai Nulia Civil Defence Volunteer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Madhyamik (10th Standard) or equivalent from a recognized board and must have completed Civil Defence Basic Training.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Contai Nulia Civil Defence Volunteer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 38 years as on 01 January 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for Contai Nulia Civil Defence Volunteer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 14 August 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for Contai Nulia Civil Defence Volunteer Recruitment 2026?
Q7. What is the selection process for Contai Nulia Civil Defence Volunteer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on Physical Measurement Test (PMT), Physical Efficiency Test (PET), and Written Examination.
